semiconductor_relevance: High — V-Tech Precision Co., Ltd specializes in high precision measuring machines essential for semiconductor manufacturing and inspection processes.
summary: V-Tech Precision Co., Ltd provides high precision measuring machines and related services, focusing on data collection, calculation, and analysis to enhance decision-making in semiconductor manufacturing. With over 20 years of experience, they serve as a major partner for Micro-Vu in the Greater China region, offering extensive support and maintenance services.

regional_presence.China: V-Tech has established 10 service sites across major cities including Suzhou, Beijing, and Dongguan.
regional_presence.Vietnam: The company also has a presence in Vietnam, supporting local semiconductor manufacturing needs.
